scope: Accepted seven-batch review integrated into authoritative inputs; release and deployment remain separate.

icons.name: Plex
icons.critique: The bright play mark merges with the yellow land; coast detail competes at 24 px.
icons.preserve: Hong Kong-centred globe, yellow land and forward playback.
icons.proposal: Simplify subpixel geography and give a larger play aperture an ink edge.

icons.name: Plex Rewind
icons.critique: Nearly the same thumbnail as Plex; the tiny rewind mark carries too much of the distinction.
icons.preserve: The same Hong Kong globe and two left-pointing transport marks.
icons.proposal: Use a violet ocean and larger, protected rewind triangles; remove the button shadow.

icons.name: Profilarr
icons.critique: Five tiny faces, clothing seams and placards collapse into visual static.
icons.preserve: Five adult profiles in a staggered lineup.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Htop
icons.critique: Dozens of narrow meter segments turn into a dense striped rectangle.
icons.preserve: A process monitor, distinct from Bottom’s dotted activity trace.
icons.proposal: Use the shared terminal shell, two CPU meters and three readable process rows.

icons.name: Lidarr
icons.critique: The record and green blades are overwhelmed by the same radar grid used by other services.
icons.preserve: Lidarr’s opposing blades, record and centre hub.
icons.proposal: Make the vinyl record dominant; remove the crosshair grid and retain two quiet grooves.

icons.name: Radarr
icons.critique: Grid, sweep, returns and bezel all compete at almost equal weight.
icons.preserve: A radial radar sweep and warm target returns.
icons.proposal: Reduce the grid to two rings; enlarge one sweep sector and two returns.

icons.name: Sonarr
icons.critique: The submarine is too small to separate the icon from Radarr at a glance.
icons.preserve: Sonar echoes above an amber submarine.
icons.proposal: Use a clear waterline, two echo arcs and a larger submarine silhouette.

icons.name: Auto-M4B
icons.critique: Book, cassette and two directional cues create a cramped diagram.
icons.preserve: Audiobook conversion: book, tape and a conversion arrow.
icons.proposal: Use one substantial book, one cassette and one broad conversion arrow.

icons.name: Audiobookshelf
icons.critique: The book stack and layered headphones compete for the same narrow centre.
icons.preserve: Books inside a headphone arch.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: LazyLibrarian
icons.critique: The tall shiny chair can read as a backpack; the book is visually pinched.
icons.preserve: A reading chair with an open book, not a librarian portrait.
icons.proposal: Broaden the chair and arms, remove inset highlights and give the book room.

icons.name: Grimmory
icons.critique: Decorative shine and little marks compete with the moon and clasp.
icons.preserve: A spellbook with a crescent, clasp and ribbon.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Disks
icons.critique: The platter looks like camera glass; the purple housing and nested highlights feel overworked.
icons.preserve: An exposed hard drive with platter, actuator and connector.
icons.proposal: Use restrained steel planes and a narrow copper actuator; reserve rings for machined parts.

icons.name: Passwords and Keys
icons.critique: The broad purple card dominates, while small dots add little recognition.
icons.preserve: Two physical keys and their open key holes.
icons.proposal: Make the keys the silhouette, with separate copper and steel materials and readable teeth.

icons.name: Flatseal
icons.decision: Accepted with final light-surface contour correction
icons.critique: The pale reel and tail flatten into an ambiguous disc on light surfaces.
icons.preserve: The tape-roll identity, including the hollow core and loose end.
icons.proposal: Retain the original reel geometry; clarify its inner core and side thickness with quiet ivory, copper and steel pigments.

icons.name: Volume Control
icons.critique: A large pale disc has little functional information; the pointer is nearly lost.
icons.preserve: A rotary volume knob with a surrounding level arc.
icons.proposal: Give the knob a dark radial groove, cooler rim and distinct low/high arc pigments. Both level segments now share the knob centre (32,34), with radius 26.5 and a constant 2-unit clear gap to the 23-unit rim.

icons.name: Keyboard layout viewer
icons.critique: The dense key grid becomes texture and gives no focal clue about layout.
icons.preserve: A naturally wide keyboard with staggered rows.
icons.proposal: Reduce key count, enlarge the spacebar and distinguish two key groups with pigment.

icons.name: System Monitor
icons.critique: Several fine grid lines and controls distract from the small waveform.
icons.preserve: A display carrying a live activity trace.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Weather
icons.critique: Layered pale cloud edges and gradients soften an otherwise clear silhouette.
icons.preserve: A warm sun partly hidden behind a white cloud.
icons.proposal: Use one cloud contour, one cool underside and fewer stronger sun rays.

icons.name: Problem Reporting
icons.critique: The bright centre reads as generic glow; the glass finish is much glossier than the family.
icons.preserve: A warning beacon with an exclamation mark and base.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Fcitx 5 Configuration
icons.critique: Small eyes, shiny head and awkward flippers give mixed penguin anatomy.
icons.preserve: The penguin-like Fcitx mascot and teal/ivory separation.
icons.proposal: Rebuild the continuous body, tuck in the beak and use broad curved flippers.

icons.name: Octo-Fiestarr
icons.critique: Thin curling arms and suction details merge below the headset.
icons.preserve: Eight arms, octopus mantle, horizontal pupils and headphones.
icons.proposal: Use eight broad tapered arms; keep cups out of the smallest view and simplify the headset.

icons.name: MariaDB
icons.critique: The frontal face and large whisker pads can read as a cat; spots and reflections add noise.
icons.preserve: The established earless seal portrait and cool coat.
icons.proposal: Use a wider earless contour, low eyes and a projecting muzzle; reduce whisker detail.

icons.name: Hyprvoice
icons.critique: The repeated thin cyan strokes have weak hierarchy beside larger filled icons.
icons.preserve: The six-bar voice waveform; a simple mark is appropriate here.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Ephemera
icons.critique: The equal-width outline makes the centre hinge and page shapes feel schematic.
icons.preserve: Transparent open-book pages and the central spine; no extra badge.
icons.proposal: Refine the paired page curves and give the hinge a restrained rose fold.

icons.name: Gum
icons.critique: Stacked sticks, sleeve planes and the patterned end disagree about the wrapper perspective.
icons.preserve: Two exposed ivory sticks, violet wrapper, mint end and rose mark.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Gitfetch
icons.critique: Multiple crossing cards and doubled arrow edges make the repository look crushed.
icons.preserve: Violet repository tray, copper Git branch and incoming mint arrow.
icons.proposal: Use the shared Lazygit terminal shell; Gitfetch has a branch and statistics, uuctl has unit-control sliders.

freshness_revision.reason: Use the shared Lazygit terminal shell; Gitfetch has a branch and statistics, uuctl has unit-control sliders.

icons.name: File Roller
icons.critique: The zipper is a thin checkerboard stripe; the archive body reads as a flat blue folder.
icons.preserve: Blue fabric archive and a working brass zipper.
icons.proposal: Enlarge the metal slider and alternate the teeth; reserve a seam for the binding and keep the body quiet.

icons.name: Tweaks
icons.critique: Many thin drawer highlights compete with the small tools; the handle and tools merge.
icons.preserve: Coral toolbox, metal spanner, screwdriver and carrying handle.
icons.proposal: Lower the spanner and screwdriver into the dark tool tray; the front lip conceals their lower sections and the carrying handle remains tallest.

icons.name: GPU Screen Recorder
icons.critique: A small featureless rectangle does not clearly distinguish GPU recording from the other monitor icons.
icons.preserve: A monitor, graphics hardware and a recording light.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Logs
icons.critique: Dense ruled lines make the page feel like lined stationery and flatten beneath the loupe.
icons.preserve: A folded log page with rows of entries and a magnifying glass.
icons.proposal: Use five structured rows and an uncluttered transparent lens, with one paper fold and restrained thickness.

icons.name: Document Viewer
icons.critique: Three differently skewed sheets and dense rules create a restless perimeter.
icons.preserve: A sheaf of documents with an illustrated front page.
icons.proposal: Use two coherent sheet angles, one image panel and three readable text rules.

icons.name: Connections
icons.critique: Small stands and equally pale screens weaken the two-computer relationship.
icons.preserve: Two offset screens and opposing transfer arrows.
icons.proposal: Keep the diagonal pairing, distinguish the screen pigments and make each arrow a clear right-angle route.

icons.name: scrcpy
icons.critique: The phone and desktop share similar pale surfaces; the transfer direction carries too little contrast.
icons.preserve: Phone-to-desktop mirroring, with the tall phone on the right.
icons.proposal: Use dark screens, a larger phone and one continuous mint arrow pointing into the desktop.

icons.name: Document Scanner
icons.critique: The paper and turquoise backplate resemble a clipboard more than a scanner.
icons.preserve: An ivory document feeding into a jade scanner.
icons.proposal: Separate the upright sheet, dark feed slot and low scanner chassis; retain one button.

icons.name: Feishin
icons.critique: A busy platter, doubled tonearm edges and scattered marks give the turntable several competing centres.
icons.preserve: Mint turntable, vinyl record, rose label and ivory tonearm.
icons.proposal: Keep two quiet grooves and a hinged tonearm with a single amber cartridge; simplify the controls.

icons.name: Tautulli
icons.critique: Fine bezel rings and numerous ticks crowd the play symbol; status blocks become specks.
icons.preserve: The approved playback-meter concept: coloured arc, amber play and three status blocks.
icons.proposal: Use concentric progress arcs, four visible ticks and a larger play mark; preserve the meter identity.

icons.name: Navidrome
icons.critique: The many groove ends and blue-glass shine make the disc more ornamental than musical.
icons.preserve: Blue disc, central label and paired interrupted grooves.
icons.proposal: Use two clean circular grooves in each quadrant, a quiet label and consistent groove endpoints.

icons.name: Beets
icons.critique: The pale curved marks look like gloss on a heart; the root has little volume.
icons.preserve: The distinctive heart-shaped beet, angular leaves and off-centre tapered root.
icons.proposal: Keep the established silhouette, shade the root on one side and replace glints with restrained growth marks.

icons.name: Tour
icons.critique: Glossy ribs and tiny basket struts make the balloon feel more polished than adjacent illustrations.
icons.preserve: Rose-and-ivory balloon, narrow throat, suspension ropes and woven basket.
icons.proposal: Use three clear fabric panels with a quiet side shadow, two ropes and one visible basket weave.

icons.name: Transmission
icons.critique: The glossy red handle is much shinier than nearby objects and the arrow changes material abruptly.
icons.preserve: The familiar red handle, ivory housing and centred downward arrow.
icons.proposal: Give the red handle a quiet underside, keep the central ivory strap and clarify the arrow against the paper body.

icons.name: Contacts
icons.critique: The address-book body looks like a plain panel; tiny tabs are stronger than its binding.
icons.preserve: Blue address book, ivory portrait and three coloured index tabs.
icons.proposal: Give the spine a clear cloth fold and narrow seam; keep the portrait simple and the tabs useful.

icons.name: Files
icons.critique: Several paper edges and folder rims crowd the opening and soften the folder silhouette.
icons.preserve: Warm tabbed folder with ivory papers and a front label.
icons.proposal: Use two paper sheets, one label and a single shallow lower/right fold.

icons.name: Unpackerr
icons.critique: The approved carton has a strong identity, but small folds and seams compete with the extraction arrow.
icons.preserve: The accepted kraft parcel, open flaps, address label and single jade extraction arrow.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Eye of GNOME
icons.critique: The large opaque-looking lens can obscure the image and makes the handle feel detached.
icons.preserve: Ivory photo frame and a large loupe at the lower left.
icons.proposal: Use transparent cyan glass, a connected handle and the shared blue-sky/mint-landscape materials.

icons.name: Image Viewer
icons.critique: Its frame and lens use slightly different proportions and highlights from Eye of GNOME.
icons.preserve: A wider photo with the inspection loupe at the lower right.
icons.proposal: Match the photo and glass materials while retaining its wider frame, right-side lens and handle direction.

icons.name: Thumbnails
icons.critique: The tiny marks below the picture look like controls, not thumbnail images.
icons.preserve: A framed landscape and a row of three image previews.
icons.proposal: Give each preview its own ivory frame and one coloured landscape shape; keep the main picture dominant.

icons.name: SimpleScreenRecorder
icons.critique: Diagonal screen shine and the bright bubble-like record button compete for attention.
icons.preserve: A single monitor with a central rose recording circle.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Help
icons.critique: The buoy reads as a segmented disc; the narrow inner rim is heavier than the safety panels.
icons.preserve: Open amber-and-ivory life ring with four safety panels.
icons.proposal: Keep an actual transparent centre and four broad panel sectors with one restrained inner seam.

icons.name: llmtrim
icons.critique: The wide curved blades and layered rings make the scissors feel heavy; their meeting point is unclear.
icons.preserve: Open copper finger loops, crossed steel blades and a rose pivot.
icons.proposal: Align both blades at one pivot, give each a narrow cutting edge and leave the finger holes transparent.

icons.name: Shelfmark
icons.critique: Tiny stitches compete with the ribbon mark, while the cord can read as a headphone arch.
icons.preserve: Rose bookmark, ivory four-point mark, jade cord and tassel.
icons.proposal: Clarify the eyelet-to-cord connection, use quiet woven margins and separate the hanging tassel from the ribbon.

icons.name: SnapRAID
icons.critique: Multiple bright chassis rims and fine vents create two glossy pills rather than storage hardware.
icons.preserve: Two stacked server units with green status lights.
icons.proposal: Use shallow steel housings, dark drive fronts and four meaningful vents per unit.

icons.name: Maps
icons.critique: The route passes behind a glossy pin without clearly following the folded map planes.
icons.preserve: Folded blue-green map, warm route and rose location pin.
icons.proposal: Use one consistent three-panel fold, quieter paper planes and a clean hollow pin.

icons.name: Tippecanoe
icons.critique: Soft fold edges and muted routes lose definition at small sizes.
icons.preserve: A folded cartographic map with sand centre, jade side panels, river and terracotta route.
icons.proposal: Strengthen the fold boundaries, simplify route bends and preserve the unpinned map identity.

icons.name: Text Editor
icons.critique: The pencil ferrule and tip merge with the rules, so the writing tool reads as a stripe.
icons.preserve: Ivory notepad, jade header and coral pencil.
icons.proposal: Give the pencil a distinct ferrule, wood tip and graphite point; leave clear room between it and the writing.

icons.name: Terminal
icons.critique: The large glossy upper rim and tiny controls dominate the terminal prompt.
icons.preserve: Physical rose terminal housing, dark glass and mint prompt.
icons.proposal: Keep the accepted casing identity, reduce its bevel, and give the prompt and cursor a consistent stroke.

icons.name: Video Player
icons.critique: The clapper stripes share a flat uninterrupted rectangle, making the hinge and board hard to distinguish.
icons.preserve: Blue clapperboard with ivory stripes and a play triangle.
icons.proposal: Open the top clapper slightly around a visible hinge and separate it from the board with quiet thickness.

icons.name: Bluetooth Adapters
icons.critique: The connector and plastic body lack a clear join, while the Bluetooth rune is narrow.
icons.preserve: Blue USB adapter, metal plug and authentic Bluetooth rune.
icons.proposal: Use a seated metal plug, two dark contact apertures and a clearer rune on a shallow plastic body.

icons.name: Clocks
icons.critique: The minute dots, top reflection and stacked rim compete with the hands.
icons.preserve: Blue circular clock, dark dial, ivory hands and rose second hand.
icons.proposal: Keep all marks concentric, strengthen the four cardinal positions and remove the arbitrary face reflection.

icons.name: Bookshelf
icons.critique: Several concentric borders make the book appear small and over-framed.
icons.preserve: The inherited Readarr book curves, rose covers, ivory page edges and circular identity.
icons.proposal: Retain the original paths, thin the ivory ring and enlarge the book slightly within the dark field.

icons.name: Byparr
icons.critique: The nested plate outlines are strong while the small chocolate marks disappear.
icons.preserve: Irregular baked cookie on an ivory plate with dark chocolate pieces.
icons.proposal: Keep the cookie outline, soften the plate groove and enlarge the chocolate marks without adding decorative shine.

icons.name: Software
icons.critique: The bag looks like a flat trapezoid; the handle feels disconnected from its upper edge.
icons.preserve: Rose shopping bag, arched handle and four ivory application squares.
icons.proposal: Seat the handle behind the bag and add one coherent side gusset while retaining the simple app grid.

icons.name: Herdr
icons.critique: Very small bolts and thin grain marks compete with the solid timber construction.
icons.preserve: Three pointed timber posts, two blue painted rails and visible fixings.
icons.proposal: Three clean terminal panes with the shared ivory prompt; the subpixel pane symbols are removed.

object_revision.reason: Three coordinated agent panes in the shared Rose Punk terminal shell. Based on Herdr's persistent terminals, split panes and agent status.

construction_refinement.reason: Three clean terminal panes with the shared ivory prompt; the subpixel pane symbols are removed.

icons.name: Parental Controls
icons.critique: The child overlaps the adult at the shoulder, merging the two bodies into one pale shape.
icons.preserve: Blue protective shield, ivory adult and amber child.
icons.proposal: Separate the heads and body contours, lower the child and keep one quiet shield side plane.

icons.name: Settings
icons.critique: Rectangular teeth look attached to a disc rather than cut into a single gear.
icons.preserve: Eight-tooth blue gear and a steel central hub.
icons.proposal: Use one continuous gear outline with tapered tooth roots, preserving the tooth count and central aperture.

icons.name: Power
icons.critique: The thick sidewall and fine grip lines compete with a strong standard symbol.
icons.preserve: Rose physical push button with a dark IEC power engraving and violet sidewall.
icons.proposal: Reduce sidewall thickness, keep the engraving concentric and limit the grip detail to four short seams.

icons.name: KOReader
icons.critique: The steep pigment ramps add striping to already intricate K/O and bookmark geometry.
icons.preserve: The exact upstream K/O forms, bookmark cutout and book-spine silhouette.
icons.proposal: Keep every source path; soften the green and ivory ramps to separate the mark from the cover more consistently.

icons.name: FlareSolverr
icons.critique: The sun is almost swallowed by the cloud, and the two cloud masses merge at small sizes.
icons.preserve: Cloudflare-derived lobes and wind aperture, warm sun and violet trailing cloud.
icons.proposal: Keep the source cloud paths; expose the sun slightly and open the trailing-cloud separation.

icons.name: Audio Player
icons.critique: The lightly tilted triangle and evenly thin bars feel less balanced than other simple media marks.
icons.preserve: A jade play silhouette with ivory waveform bars and a small warm endpoint.
icons.proposal: Balance the triangle around the waveform and give the central amplitude a clear visual hierarchy.

icons.name: mpv Media Player
icons.critique: The bright inner ring is nearly as strong as the play mark, and the blue disc resembles other players.
icons.preserve: mpv’s circular identity, inner ring and ivory play triangle.
icons.proposal: Use a restrained violet disc, a quieter concentric ring and a larger optically centred play mark.

icons.name: Bookmarks
icons.critique: The ribbon and ivory page have strong identity, but their top join and folded corner feel unfinished.
icons.preserve: The approved ivory document, jade ribbon notch and two text rules.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: GIMP
icons.critique: The tiny pupils recede at launcher sizes while the isolated nose highlight attracts attention.
icons.preserve: Exact Wilber contour, asymmetric eyes, plum nose and amber paintbrush.
icons.proposal: Retain the original mascot paths, broaden the pupils slightly and quiet the nose highlight with a cooler lavender coat.

icons.name: Disk Usage Analyzer
icons.critique: The pie chart does not convincingly communicate the application; the user requested a variation of Disks.
icons.preserve: The accepted Disks housing, machined platter, copper actuator and physical proportions.
icons.proposal: Use the same hard-drive geometry with a jade housing and an integrated capacity strip in place of the connector. No pie chart.

icons.name: Scrutiny
icons.critique: The pale lenses and fine monitoring marks compete with doubled frame edges.
icons.preserve: Rose spectacles with a pulse trace on the left and three health bars on the right.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Mullvad VPN
icons.critique: Large exposed ears and several tiny highlights compete with the mining lamp.
icons.preserve: The accepted mole portrait, amber helmet, lamp and soft brown muzzle.
icons.proposal: Tuck the ears closer to the helmet, quiet the nose highlight and give the lamp and coat clear material separation.

icons.name: Prowlarr
icons.critique: Two circular muzzle pads and many whisker dots make the tiger feel assembled from separate shapes.
icons.preserve: Round tiger portrait, forehead stripes, ivory muzzle and warm coat.
icons.proposal: Join the muzzle into one continuous form, slightly reduce the eyes and add a quiet right-cheek shadow.

icons.name: Collie
icons.critique: The dense muzzle dots and nose shine compete with the sable blaze and tipped ears.
icons.preserve: The established collie contour, tipped ears, ivory blaze and long muzzle.
icons.proposal: Keep the portrait geometry; lower the nose slightly, quiet secondary face marks and shade one cheek.

icons.name: VLC media player
icons.critique: Flat colour across the cone and broad base makes its taper hard to read.
icons.preserve: Orange traffic cone, two ivory bands and broad square foot.
icons.proposal: Wrap the bands around one tapered surface and give the plastic a restrained lateral material ramp.

icons.name: Obsidian
icons.critique: The darkest facets merge on plum, while the upper rose face dominates the stone.
icons.preserve: The exact chipped-stone contour and four curved upstream facets.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Google Chrome
icons.critique: The thick pale centre rim reads as a separate button on top of the coloured blades.
icons.preserve: Three interlocking rose, gold and jade blades with blue optical glass.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Google Photos
icons.critique: Uneven pigment strength makes the lower petals visually heavier than the upper pair.
icons.preserve: The exact four-petal pinwheel and warm/cool channel order.
icons.proposal: Keep all petal geometry and use coordinated restrained ramps so each petal carries similar weight.

icons.name: Calendar
icons.critique: Three stacked page edges and mixed binding highlights compete with the date.
icons.preserve: Rose header, ivory page, jade page edge, two binding rings and outlined 31.
icons.proposal: Use one shallow page stack, consistent binding hardware and a cleaner date drawing.

icons.name: Google Calendar
icons.critique: The date is crowded against the curled corner and the binding differs from Calendar.
icons.preserve: Blue header, ivory page, amber folded corner and 31.
icons.proposal: Use the same paper and binding construction as Calendar while preserving the blue header and amber corner.

icons.name: Gmail
icons.critique: The large pale lower panel has little paper structure, while the M fold has a soft doubled edge.
icons.preserve: Gmail red M and folded ivory envelope.
icons.proposal: Keep the proposed paper construction and restore red using the existing Gmailtjik red pigment ramp.

icons.name: Color Profile Viewer
icons.critique: Some pale petals disappear on ivory and the central overlap carries uneven colour weight.
icons.preserve: Eight pointed colour petals in their established hue order.
icons.proposal: Preserve the flower construction, deepen the exposed pigments slightly and balance the petal proportions.

icons.name: uuctl
icons.critique: The small stand and narrow screen make the system terminal feel lighter than other hardware icons.
icons.preserve: A steel monitor with a mint terminal prompt, distinct from the rose Terminal enclosure.
icons.proposal: Use the shared Lazygit terminal shell; Gitfetch has a branch and statistics, uuctl has unit-control sliders.

freshness_revision.reason: Use the shared Lazygit terminal shell; Gitfetch has a branch and statistics, uuctl has unit-control sliders.

icons.name: Homepage
icons.critique: The curled bookmark tails look like bent curtains at small sizes.
icons.preserve: The deliberately simple rose-roof house with blue and jade bookmark windows.
icons.proposal: Keep the house and seven-shape flat treatment; straighten the two tails and give their notches matching proportions.

icons.name: Starship
icons.critique: The bright white rocket and star sit somewhat apart from the family’s warm light pigments.
icons.preserve: The exact rocket, star, exhaust and circular identity geometry.
icons.proposal: Retain all upstream paths, use warm ivory for the marks and a slightly deeper violet field.

icons.name: yuzu
icons.critique: The thin coral and cyan halves lose contrast against light backgrounds.
icons.preserve: The exact opposing half-circle forms and their internal apertures.
icons.proposal: Preserve every source path and deepen only the existing pigment ramps.

icons.name: Solaar
icons.critique: The ivory sun is clear, but the light jade field has little separation from pale surfaces.
icons.preserve: The original sun-and-hub cutout in its rounded jade identity tile.
icons.proposal: Retain original geometry and deepen the jade field while keeping warm ivory intact.

icons.name: FNM
icons.critique: Several similar green facets merge, reducing the crystal’s useful structure.
icons.preserve: Faceted Node hexagon and plain unoutlined lightning bolt.
icons.proposal: Keep all facets and bolt geometry; separate the cool shadow plane from the brighter jade face.

icons.name: Flatpak
icons.critique: The pale blue rim is weaker than the amber and jade faces at small sizes.
icons.preserve: The exact open package contour, negative spaces and three coloured faces.
icons.proposal: Keep the source geometry and balance the face pigments, especially the blue rim.

icons.name: Characters
icons.critique: The small A and cross mark are too fine beside the large omega.
icons.preserve: An ivory omega with amber A and ivory cross on a blue field.
icons.proposal: Rebalance the three authored glyphs, strengthen the smaller strokes and deepen the backing slightly.

icons.name: Rust
icons.critique: Separate rectangular teeth and tiny rivets crowd the monogram’s circular frame.
icons.preserve: Twelve-tooth rose gear, dark centre and ivory R.
icons.proposal: Build a continuous toothed contour, omit subpixel rivets and preserve the large R aperture.

icons.name: Neovim
icons.critique: The offset side faces create a heavy doubled silhouette beneath the three coloured strokes.
icons.preserve: Exact cyan, rose and violet N faces and their three-dimensional construction.
icons.proposal: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

freshness_revision.reason: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

icons.name: Python
icons.critique: The thick coloured contours narrow the gaps between the two snakes.
icons.preserve: Exact PSF snake curves, dark eye apertures and blue/amber separation.
icons.proposal: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

freshness_revision.reason: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

icons.name: Steam
icons.critique: The dark crank-arm edge is heavy compared with the blue connecting rod.
icons.preserve: The established tapered linkage, circular bearings and ivory crank arm.
icons.proposal: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

freshness_revision.reason: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

icons.name: Bottom
icons.critique: Densely packed dots merge along the sharp central rise.
icons.preserve: The canonical plum terminal shell, ivory prompt and multicoloured dotted activity trace.
icons.proposal: Use fewer evenly separated samples so the dotted trace survives at 24 px.

icons.name: Lazygit
icons.critique: The branch changes direction abruptly and feels heavier than its nodes.
icons.preserve: The terminal shell, copper branch and three amber commit nodes.
icons.proposal: Smooth the branch junction and slightly reduce its stroke weight.

icons.name: Tennis
icons.critique: Heavy outlines eat the six colour cells at small sizes.
icons.preserve: The terminal shell and six distinct colour blocks in a three-by-two grid.
icons.proposal: Use explicit gaps and clean filled cells with consistent corner radii.

icons.name: Vivid
icons.critique: The delicate tree connections recede before the colour swatches.
icons.preserve: A fine branching colour tree inside the shared terminal shell.
icons.proposal: Strengthen the tree slightly and close the visual gap to each coloured leaf.

icons.name: Lutris
icons.critique: The rose eye and nose blur into the otter silhouette.
icons.preserve: All original otter contours, curled tail and cream belly.
icons.proposal: Keep the source geometry and darken only the eye and nose.

icons.name: Firefox
icons.critique: A small floating highlight crowds the globe behind the fox.
icons.preserve: The exact upstream fox silhouette and blue globe with mint continents.
icons.proposal: Remove the stray highlight and separate the cool globe from the warm fox with quieter pigments.

icons.name: Fish shell
icons.critique: Small scale marks clutter the body, while the ventral fin hangs low.
icons.preserve: Jade fish identity, natural horizontal proportions and the shared flat style with Kitty.
icons.proposal: Approved flat jade fish with a mint contour and a single dark chevron serving as its fin. No eye, separate fins or gradients; matches Kitty visual language.

kitty_style_revision.reason: Approved flat jade fish with a mint contour and a single dark chevron serving as its fin. No eye, separate fins or gradients; matches Kitty visual language.

icons.name: Bun
icons.critique: The dough shading is compressed at the base, and eye glints dominate the tiny face.
icons.preserve: Official bun contour, three pleats, face and blush.
icons.proposal: Spread the warm dough ramp over more of the form and reduce the eye glints.

icons.name: Brave
icons.critique: The pink base of the mane competes with its copper upper half.
icons.preserve: Exact upstream lion paths, face apertures and ivory face.
icons.proposal: Use a more continuous copper-to-ochre mane while retaining all geometry.

icons.name: Telegram
icons.critique: The pale blue wings and pink bands have similar visual weight.
icons.preserve: Original plane contour, folded blue wings and rose-red/ivory bands.
icons.proposal: Deepen the blue faces and rose-red bands while preserving the folded construction.

icons.name: Mailtjik
icons.critique: The bright white flap feels heavier than the narrow airmail stripes.
icons.preserve: Tjik rounded-square frame, diagonal airmail border and envelope fold.
icons.proposal: Use matching warm ivory in the stripe and flap and reduce the fold stroke slightly.

icons.name: Gmailtjik
icons.critique: The pale frame competes with the red M; the diagonal fold sits slightly low.
icons.preserve: Rounded Tjik frame, dark interior and original red pigment.
icons.proposal: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

freshness_revision.reason: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

icons.name: Seerr
icons.critique: Parallel iris accents add a second focal point beside the crescent pupil.
icons.preserve: Violet iris and the exact crescent pupil geometry.
icons.proposal: Reduce the secondary iris accents so the crescent remains the first read.

icons.name: OBS Studio
icons.critique: The broad pale ring dominates the three-blade swirl.
icons.preserve: Exact OBS swirl and circular dark backing.
icons.proposal: Narrow and quiet the violet rim so the swirl carries the identity.

icons.name: RPM Fusion
icons.critique: Electron marks and orbit lines crowd the blue disc edge.
icons.preserve: Three crossed atomic orbits, amber nucleus and rose/cyan electrons.
icons.proposal: Inset the orbits, slightly reduce electrons and deepen the blue field.

icons.name: Docker
icons.critique: The generic enamel ramp adds a pale stripe above a saturated violet hull.
icons.preserve: Exact whale silhouette, stacked containers and original negative spaces.
icons.proposal: Retain all geometry and replace the glossy ramp with a restrained periwinkle surface.

icons.name: Bitwarden
icons.critique: The shield is already coherent; its blue is slightly dull beside related utility marks.
icons.preserve: Exact filled shield and open right half; deliberately flat treatment.
icons.proposal: Make a small blue pigment adjustment without adding bevels or detail.

icons.name: Tailscale
icons.critique: Filled dots look smaller than the outer diameter of the hollow nodes.
icons.preserve: Exact three-by-three arrangement and four filled node positions.
icons.proposal: Increase filled-node diameter for optical balance and lift the cyan shadow slightly for plum backgrounds.

icons.name: Signal
icons.decision: Original geometry and accepted pigments (unchanged from RC13)
icons.critique: The thin dashed ring is visually uneven around the speech bubble.
icons.preserve: Periwinkle speech bubble, tail and surrounding dashed identity ring.
icons.proposal: Retain the original geometry and proposed periwinkle pigments (#697fcb ring, #6d82cf bubble). Those pigments already match RC13, so this selection is byte-identical to the original.

icons.name: Spotify
icons.critique: The very light green disc weakens the ivory waves on light surfaces.
icons.preserve: Jade disc and the original three curved sound-wave strokes.
icons.proposal: Deepen the jade field and keep the three waves clean and warm ivory.

icons.name: Zoom
icons.critique: The bright blue field and cool white camera sit apart from the warmer shared palette.
icons.preserve: Exact camera silhouette, body-to-wing gap and circular blue identity.
icons.proposal: Quiet the blue field and use the shared warm ivory camera pigment.

icons.name: ZapZap
icons.critique: The handset leans toward the lower right of the speech bubble.
icons.preserve: Mint speech bubble and the original ivory telephone silhouette.
icons.proposal: Nudge the handset upward and left and deepen the jade field to protect the ivory handset.

icons.name: Bluetooth Manager
icons.critique: The rune has unequal upper and lower triangles; the capsule has an unnecessary ramp.
icons.preserve: Blue vertical capsule, ivory Bluetooth rune and status dot.
icons.proposal: Make the rune symmetric, retain the flat treatment and use a single blue pigment.

icons.name: QGIS Desktop
icons.critique: Thick face seams crowd the arrow where it crosses the Q.
icons.preserve: Exact connected Q and arrow paths with jade, coral and amber planes.
icons.proposal: Narrow the existing seams so the coloured faces and apertures remain clear.

icons.name: Fonts
icons.critique: The lowercase a has a pinched bowl, and its amber strokes are faint against the blue tile.
icons.preserve: Deliberately flat blue tile with a large ivory A and smaller amber a.
icons.proposal: Draw a clean single-storey bowl and stem and deepen the blue backing to support both letter colours.

icons.name: Tinty
icons.critique: The two droplet halves use different lower curves, leaving an uneven colour seam.
icons.preserve: Canonical terminal shell and the cyan, violet and rose pigment droplet.
icons.proposal: Keep the unchanged RC13 original, as requested.

icons.name: Chezmoi
icons.critique: The pale wall has little depth, and the window sits low beside the doorway.
icons.preserve: Cyan house, blue roof, dark door and ivory window.
icons.proposal: Keep the accepted cyan house and rename this identity Chezmoi.

icons.name: Chezetc
icons.critique: The house differs from Dotjik mainly by colour, so its system role is unclear.
icons.preserve: The same house geometry as Chezmoi, with red walls and roof.
icons.proposal: Use the accepted Chezmoi house paths, door, window and side plane in red; rename this identity Chezetc.

icons.name: Synctjik
icons.critique: Its thinner frame and heavier centre mark differ from the rest of the Tjik family.
icons.preserve: Copper rounded-square frame and the two opposing open return paths.
icons.proposal: Use the family frame proportions and rebalance the internal mark with a lighter stroke.

icons.name: Runtjik
icons.critique: The command symbol is slightly small, while its lower pigment ramp becomes muted.
icons.preserve: Blue-violet Tjik frame and the exact four-loop command mark.
icons.proposal: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

freshness_revision.reason: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

icons.name: Notjik
icons.critique: The tiny centre square looks like a glossy button rather than a simple note marker.
icons.preserve: Cyan Tjik frame, dark field and solitary rounded-square centre.
icons.proposal: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

freshness_revision.reason: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

icons.name: Tjikup
icons.critique: The chevron sits low and feels heavier than the other Tjik centre marks.
icons.preserve: Amber Tjik frame and blush upward chevron.
icons.proposal: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

freshness_revision.reason: Use the shared warm ivory #fff0da for functional foreground marks, keeping identity frame colours.

icons.name: Quickshell
icons.critique: The heavy gear ring closes down the Q counter at small sizes.
icons.preserve: Exact toothed Q contour, diagonal tail and clipped jade backing.
icons.proposal: Open the counter slightly and reduce tail weight while keeping the outer geometry.

icons.name: Strata
icons.critique: The ivory upper ribbon has a thick contour unlike the other ribbon faces.
icons.preserve: Exact interlocking S ribbons, blue lower face and cyan upper tab.
icons.proposal: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

freshness_revision.reason: Follow the majority filled-logo treatment: remove added keylines or offset shadows; retain identifying geometry and internal spaces.

icons.name: Drizzle Studio
icons.critique: The pale lower rain strokes disappear against ivory, unlike the saturated top row.
icons.preserve: Six diagonal rain strokes, with longer rose strokes above shorter blush strokes.
icons.proposal: Keep every stroke and gap; bring both pigment ramps into a clearer rose/blush relationship.

icons.name: GNOME
icons.critique: The pale toe tips and dark heel make one continuous logo feel unevenly weighted.
icons.preserve: Exact upstream foot silhouette, four toes and curled sole aperture.
icons.proposal: Use a quieter, deeper rose ramp across the original geometry.

icons.name: Fedora Media Writer
icons.critique: The ivory f has weak separation from the bright periwinkle backing.
icons.preserve: Exact Fedora silhouette and f/infinity geometry.
icons.proposal: Deepen the blue field while retaining the bright mark and deliberately flat construction.

icons.name: ChatGPT
icons.critique: The light turquoise interlace loses definition against its ivory backing at launcher sizes.
icons.preserve: Exact sixfold knot and warm light backing.
icons.proposal: Strengthen the turquoise pigment without altering the interlaced paths or their gaps.

icons.name: Discord
icons.critique: The blue eye marks sit apart from the shared dark ink used in other faces.
icons.preserve: Exact controller silhouette, curved lower notches and paired eye geometry.
icons.proposal: Keep the mark flat; use shared plum eyes and a slightly quieter rose body.

icons.name: oo7
icons.critique: Fingerprint strokes become crowded around the inner curl at 24 px.
icons.preserve: All five original fingerprint paths and open ridge ends.
icons.proposal: Reduce ridge weight slightly and use a deeper rose pigment to keep the open gaps legible.

icons.name: Hyprland
icons.critique: The bright upper cyan fades on white while the lower blue carries most of the weight.
icons.preserve: The exact open droplet contour and its internal negative space.
icons.proposal: Balance the cyan-to-jade ramp, retaining the thin upper points and broad base.

icons.name: Nginx
icons.critique: The darker lower green recedes on plum compared with the top of the N.
icons.preserve: Exact rounded N and its deliberately unbacked jade treatment.
icons.proposal: Lift the shadow pigment slightly, keeping the existing geometry and green identity.

icons.name: Greetjik
icons.critique: The narrow blue and jade ribbons crowd each other below the crest.
icons.preserve: Swept rose-and-amber crest with violet, blue and jade trailing ribbons.
icons.proposal: Open the inner ribbon spacing slightly and coordinate the trailing pigments without changing the outer silhouette.

icons.name: Sublime Text
icons.critique: The copper return face is close in brightness to the two gold faces.
icons.preserve: Exact folded S, dark case and alternating gold/copper faces.
icons.proposal: Deepen the return face so the folded construction reads without extra highlights.

icons.name: DuckDB
icons.critique: The dark outside rim is heavier than the small beak aperture needs.
icons.preserve: Original yellow duck mark, circular head aperture and dark backing.
icons.proposal: Thin the outside backing slightly while preserving the bright yellow and all upstream paths.

icons.name: UV
icons.critique: The very saturated purple feels isolated from the family’s quieter violet marks.
icons.preserve: Exact U-shaped monogram, narrow opening and flat treatment.
icons.proposal: Make a modest violet pigment adjustment with no added texture or geometry changes.

icons.name: Vite
icons.critique: The vivid top-to-bottom shine makes the flat lightning silhouette look glossy.
icons.preserve: Exact stepped lightning geometry and rose identity.
icons.proposal: Replace the generic glossy ramp with a restrained three-stop rose surface.

icons.name: Zen Browser
icons.critique: The lower blush and ivory arcs become grey beside the vivid rose outer ring.
icons.preserve: Exact concentric radii, dark backing and rose/blush/ivory channel colours.
icons.proposal: Keep all circle geometry and lift the lower pigments so the rings retain their colour around the full circumference.

icons.name: PhotoCraft
icons.critique: The pale tips of the nine tails compete with the ivory face, especially at 24 px.
icons.preserve: All nine tail contours, seated fox proportions and the approved face.
icons.proposal: Quiet the lavender tail-tip pigment so the face remains the focal point; preserve all geometry.

icons.name: PdfCraft
icons.critique: Dark maroon patches at the lower mane read as separate masses around the chin.
icons.preserve: The approved lion head, muzzle proportions, copper mane and ivory whisker pads.
icons.proposal: Lift and coordinate only the mane shadow pigments; keep the full portrait geometry.

icons.name: FigCraft
icons.critique: A floating back highlight adds a small stripe unrelated to the body construction.
icons.preserve: The approved chameleon, large turret eye, folded limbs and continuous curled tail.
icons.proposal: Remove the isolated back highlight and bring the rear leg pigment closer to the body shadow.

icons.name: Craft Anything
icons.critique: The lower chest patch has a stronger purple boundary than the neck needs.
icons.preserve: The approved corvid profile, skull, brow and carefully corrected beak geometry.
icons.proposal: Blend only the lower feather plane into the main coat; keep every profile and beak path.

icons.name: WordCraft
icons.critique: The long diagonal pencil makes the paper look undersized beside the other document icons.
icons.preserve: Folded ivory page, three ink lines and the constructed blue pencil with rose eraser.
icons.proposal: Shorten the whole pencil uniformly around its tip, retaining its shape and overlap with the page.

icons.name: DeckCraft
icons.critique: The round accent competes with the three narrow bars at launcher sizes.
icons.preserve: Presentation screen, ivory slide, three coloured bars and violet stand.
icons.proposal: Widen the chart bars slightly and reduce the accent circle; preserve the screen and stand.

icons.name: CADCraft
icons.critique: The dashed construction guides are uneven at small sizes and the aperture tint is slightly heavy.
icons.preserve: Exact set-square silhouette, translucent aperture, concentric quarter-circle and amber endpoint.
icons.proposal: Use slightly stronger, more frequent guide dashes and quieter transparent cyan in the aperture.

icons.name: GridCraft
icons.critique: The grid and selected cell have almost equal contrast, while the large handle crowds the cell corner.
icons.preserve: Folded spreadsheet page, jade headers, amber selected cell and dark selection border.
icons.proposal: Quiet the ordinary grid lines and reduce the selection handle, keeping the selected cell dominant.

icons.name: VectorCraft
icons.critique: The eye, jaw and horns remain distinct at 24 px; the belly plane explains the neck volume.
icons.preserve: Approved dragon silhouette, horns, tooth, amber belly and jade coat.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork. Further smoothing would weaken the dragon’s angular identity.

icons.name: LightCraft
icons.critique: The lynx reads from ear tufts, narrow eyes and cheek ruff before the small face details.
icons.preserve: Approved symmetrical lynx face, tufted ears, amber coat and ivory muzzle.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork; fine tufts can recede at small sizes without losing the identity.

icons.name: EffectCraft
icons.critique: The corrected neck, jaw and muzzle form a convincing profile. The horn remains secondary.
icons.preserve: Approved unicorn anatomy, curved neck, rose mane and ivory coat.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork. No further anatomy or highlight changes are justified.

icons.name: DesignCraft
icons.critique: The two face patches and scarf distinguish the cat from the other portraits.
icons.preserve: Approved cat contour, mismatched coat patches, amber eyes and patterned scarf.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork; the small scarf dots disappear gracefully.

icons.name: TextureCraft
icons.critique: The curved stripes follow the neck and leave a clear eye and muzzle.
icons.preserve: Approved zebra profile, rounded neck, upright mane and wrapped dark stripes.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork. Avoid turning its natural stripes into regular graphic chevrons.

icons.name: SoundCraft
icons.critique: The corrected fine beak and long tail establish the bird; the pale breast keeps the body readable.
icons.preserve: Approved bird proportions, split singing beak, folded wing and sound marks.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork, including the explicitly corrected beak.

icons.name: FilmCraft
icons.critique: The owl remains the strongest example of controlled geometry and focused facial detail.
icons.preserve: Frozen owl reference: complete silhouette, eye rings, beak, wings and feet.
icons.proposal: Keep the reference byte-for-byte unchanged.

icons.name: Camera
icons.critique: The lens, grip and hardware each carry purposeful material detail with a clear hierarchy.
icons.preserve: Frozen camera reference, including all original geometry and material treatment.
icons.proposal: Keep the reference byte-for-byte unchanged.

icons.name: Bartjik
icons.critique: The ring and central dot read cleanly; the circular identity already distinguishes it from framed Tjik apps.
icons.preserve: Original circular silhouette, rose ring, dark field and light centre.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork. Do not square the ring or add an outer tile.

icons.name: Codex
icons.critique: The filled wavy contour and terminal apertures remain strong across sizes and surfaces.
icons.preserve: Exact attributed wavy silhouette, prompt apertures and violet variant.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork; added surface detail would compete with the apertures.

icons.name: Codex LB
icons.critique: The blue version has the same clear geometry as Codex and is distinguishable without extra detail.
icons.preserve: Exact shared silhouette and apertures, with its established blue pigment.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork and the paired variant relationship.

icons.name: kitty
icons.critique: The deliberately flat cat-terminal mark is simple, recognisable and appropriately different from animal portraits.
icons.preserve: Cat-ear contour, pale rim, rose fill and dark terminal prompt.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork. Do not add fur texture or material shading.

icons.name: Zed
icons.critique: The official nested strokes stay readable because the ivory is protected by the dark backing.
icons.preserve: Exact upstream monogram, dark backing and ivory Stable channel.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork, including its existing optical weight.

icons.name: Zed Preview
icons.critique: The shared monogram and distinct blue pigment identify Preview without a second symbol.
icons.preserve: Exact upstream monogram, dark backing and blue Preview channel.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork and the shared geometry with Stable and Nightly.

icons.name: Zed Nightly
icons.critique: The amber channel remains clear beside the ivory and blue versions at small sizes.
icons.preserve: Exact upstream monogram, dark backing and amber Nightly channel.
icons.proposal: Recommend keeping the current artwork and preserving the channel colour distinction.
